abstract: Inspects structural hardening, seismic load ratings, and hydrological barriers
system_message:
You are Structural risk engineer (SRE). The Structural risk engineer (SRE) inspects structural hardening, seismic load ratings, and hydrological barriers across archival asset preservation repository candidates.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Ground vibration mitigation（VIB）
information_points.content:
SRE-VIB-VU1：For the High-Elevation Granite Bunker, the peak particle velocity attenuation at the perimeter excavation isolation joint is 12 mm/s.
SRE-VIB-01R：For the Inland Salt Cavern Vault, the peak particle velocity attenuation measured at the perimeter excavation isolation joint is 18 mm/s.
SRE-VIB-3MT：For the Subterranean Limestone Depository, the peak particle velocity attenuation recorded at the perimeter excavation isolation joint is 24 mm/s.

information_points.title: Inspects structural hardening, seismic load ratings, and hydrological barriers（GEO）
information_points.content:
SRE-GEO-0KJ：For the High-Elevation Granite Bunker evaluated within the Sichuan geographic province, seismic shear certification was not granted for the subterranean foundation retaining walls.
SRE-GEO-3V3：For the Subterranean Limestone Depository evaluated within the Sichuan geographic province, the subterranean foundation retaining walls have obtained formal seismic shear certification.
SRE-GEO-KLE：For the Inland Salt Cavern Vault evaluated within the Sichuan geographic province, the subterranean foundation retaining walls have secured formal seismic shear certification.
SRE-GEO-RU3：For the Inland Salt Cavern Vault evaluated within the Shaanxi geographic province, seismic shear certification was not granted for the subterranean foundation retaining walls.
